command:
install -d -m 0755 /opt/inventory cat > /opt/inventory/app.py <<'ANTRIEB_APP_EOF' #!/usr/bin/python3 import json import os import socket from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer BACKEND = os.environ.get("BACKEND_NAME", socket.gethostname()) ITEMS = [ {"sku": "INV-1001", "name": "Keyboard", "quantity": 24}, {"sku": "INV-1002", "name": "Mouse", "quantity": 36}, {"sku": "INV-1003", "name": "Monitor", "quantity": 12}, ] class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def send_body(self, status, content_type, body): encoded = body.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(encoded))) self.send_header("X-Backend-Server", BACKEND) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(encoded) def do_GET(self): if self.path == "/healthz": self.send_body(200, "application/json", json.dumps({"status": "ok", "backend": BACKEND})) elif self.path == "/api/inventory": self.send_body(200, "application/json", json.dumps({"backend": BACKEND, "items": ITEMS})) elif self.path == "/": rows = "".join(f"{i['sku']}{i['name']}{i['quantity']}" for i in ITEMS) page = f"""Inventory

Inventory Application

Served by {BACKEND}

{rows}
SKUItemQuantity
""" self.send_body(200, "text/html; charset=utf-8", page) else: self.send_body(404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Not found\n") def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print(f"{self.address_string()} - {fmt % args}", flush=True) ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever() ANTRIEB_APP_EOF chmod 0755 /opt/inventory/app.py cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF' [Unit] Description=Inventory web application After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] Type=simple Environment=BACKEND_NAME=%H ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory/app.py Restart=always RestartSec=2 User=nobody Group=nobody NoNewPrivileges=true PrivateTmp=true ProtectSystem=strict ProtectHome=true [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF systemctl daemon-reload systemctl enable --now inventory.service firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp firewall-cmd --reload

global
    log         127.0.0.1 local2
    user        haproxy
    group       haproxy
    daemon
    maxconn     2048

defaults
    mode                    http
    log                     global
    option                  httplog
    option                  dontlognull
    option                  redispatch
    retries                 3
    timeout http-request    10s
    timeout connect         5s
    timeout client          30s
    timeout server          30s

frontend inventory_http

    default_backend inventory_backends

    http-check expect status 200
    server node2 10.100.35.11:8080 check inter 2s fall 3 rise 2
